normalize_answer_text: normalize an answer string by removing articles, punctuation, and extra whitespace for QA evaluation
compute_f1_score: compute the F1 score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers using token overlap
compute_exact_match_score: compute the exact match score between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
compute_rouge_score: compute ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores between a prediction and multiple ground truth answers
compute_em_score: compute the exact match score between a single prediction and ground truth using a normalization function
